metadata.name: LucidLink File API - Development Rules
metadata.description: Business rules and constraints for Bob AI Developer

rule.name: No Hardcoded Credentials
rule.description: Bob must never commit hardcoded passwords, API keys, or tokens
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Cannot commit hardcoded credentials. Use environment variables instead.

rule.name: No SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
rule.description: Bob must use parameterized queries, never string concatenation
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Potential SQL injection vulnerability. Use parameterized queries.

rule.name: Require Authentication Middleware
rule.description: All API routes must have authentication
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: API route should include authentication middleware.

rule.name: File Size Limits
rule.description: File upload size must be between 1MB and 500MB
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: File size must be between 1MB and 500MB. Requested size violates policy.

rule.name: Input Validation Required
rule.description: All user inputs must be validated
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: User input should be validated and sanitized.

rule.name: Email Format Validation
rule.description: Email addresses must follow RFC 5322 standard
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Invalid email format. Must follow RFC 5322 standard.

rule.name: Test Coverage Required
rule.description: All new features must have unit tests
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: New feature should include unit tests (80% coverage minimum).

rule.name: No Console.log in Production
rule.description: Remove console.log statements before committing
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Remove console.log statements. Use proper logging library.

rule.name: Error Handling Required
rule.description: All async functions must have try-catch blocks
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Async function should include try-catch error handling.

rule.name: No Direct Database Access
rule.description: Must use service layer, never direct DB queries in routes
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Routes must use service layer. No direct database access allowed.

rule.name: Rate Limiting Required
rule.description: Public APIs must have rate limiting
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Public API should include rate limiting middleware.

rule.name: API Versioning Required
rule.description: All API endpoints must include version in path
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: API endpoint should include version (e.g., /api/v1/).

rule.name: No Breaking Changes Without Approval
rule.description: Breaking API changes require explicit approval
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Breaking API change detected. Requires approval from API team.

rule.name: No Direct Production Commits
rule.description: All changes must go through PR review
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Cannot commit directly to main. Create a PR instead.

rule.name: Tests Must Pass
rule.description: All tests must pass before merging
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Tests must pass before merging. Fix failing tests first.

rule.name: Semantic Versioning
rule.description: Version numbers must follow semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH)
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Version should follow semantic versioning (e.g., 1.2.3).

rule.name: No PII in Logs
rule.description: Personal Identifiable Information must not be logged
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Cannot log PII data. Remove sensitive information from logs.

rule.name: GDPR Compliance
rule.description: User data must be deletable (right to be forgotten)
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Ensure GDPR compliance - users must be able to delete their data.

rule.name: License Headers Required
rule.description: All source files must include license header
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Source file should include license header.

rule.name: LucidLink Branding
rule.description: UI must maintain LucidLink brand colors and style
rule.message: ⚠️ WARNING: Maintain LucidLink brand colors in UI changes.

rule.name: Demo Data Only
rule.description: Use mock/demo data, never real customer data
rule.message: ❌ BLOCKED: Demo must use mock data only. No real customer data allowed.
